newsitem.title: USA: Amoco president meets Israelis on pipeline project.
newsitem.headline: Amoco president meets Israelis on pipeline project.

text.p: Amoco Corp President William Lowry said he met with Israel's Minister of National Infrastructures Ariel Sharon on Wednesday to discuss the Israel-Egypt pipeline project.
The pipeline, dubbed 'Peace Pipeline' by U.S. officials, is seen as a significant step in U.S. policy toward a lasting peace in the Middle East through shared economic development in the region.
But Lowry stressed after their meeting at the First Annual Israel-North America Business Conference in New York that they had reached no agreement.

"We just came here to have a discussion," Lowry said, saying that the talks focused on the pipeline project in particular. "The whole thing is yet to be resolved. (The Israelis) are working through their end of it and we just have to take this through the normal process."
Amoco comprises 33 percent of Egypt Trans Gas Co, which proposed the pipeline. Agip SpA has a 33 percent holding and Egypt Gas has 34 percent of the company.
